scope: Corollary 1.2 (Sharp Bondi inequality in the CKS class) of the manuscript “Area-controlled end replacement and the Bondi Penrose inequality in the CKS class” (preprints/Area-controlled-end-replacement-and-the-Bondi-Penrose-inequality-in-the-CKS-class-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dbf670183435f218), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under the hypotheses of Theorem 1.1, assume θ+(S) ≤ 0, with normal into Ω, and Amin,g(S) > 0. Then √ E2 B − |PB|2 ≥ √ Amin,g(S) 16π . (1.7) The boundary may be disconnected. For every m > 0 there is a horizon-regular Schwarzschild hyperboloidal exterior attaining equality with mB = m and Amin,g(S) = 16πm2.
